correctness.rationale: Edge survival indicator gives G_i(p)=sum_{e:i descendant} length(e)(1-p)^{|C_e|}. For <=4 taxa, an LCA split is singleton-versus-other or (2,2), so gain difference after dividing by q=1-p is monotone or affine and has at most one strict crossing. At 5 taxa only (3,2) produces quadratic Aq^2-Bq+C; conditions C>0, 0<B<2A, B^2>4AC, A-B+C>0 characterize two roots inside (0,1). Given rational witness yields G_a-G_d=q(q-1/5)(q-4/5), with a dominating b,c and d dominating e, so a globally wins near both ends. Direct rational checks at five q values confirm crossings; symbolic proof handles continuum.
